calls.title: GrowthBook and Aras Corporation - Technical Demo
calls.summary: The meeting focused on GrowthBook's capabilities in empowering product managers through controlled feature releases and measuring their impact. Key points included the importance of experimentation for validating features, allowing A/B testing to prove value before full rollout. Feature flagging was discussed for enabling quick rollbacks and flexible deployments across various hosting environments, including SaaS and on-premises. GrowthBook's statistical analysis tools provide clear insights into feature performance, aiding data-driven decision-making. The pricing model supports predictable budgeting based on the number of experiments rather than the volume of users, making it suitable for diverse customer needs. Future steps involve sharing tailored materials and scoping pilot experiments with customer teams.
calls.keywords: feature flagging, experimentation, product management, SaaS, On-Prem, telemetry

calls.title: GrowthBook and Aras Corporation - Technical Demo
calls.summary: GrowthBook provides product managers with tools for testing and validating feature impact through controlled experiments and feature flagging, promoting data-driven decisions. PMs can run A/B tests to validate features' value before wide rollout, while the platform allows for easy toggling of features for specific users. It also addresses telemetry gaps through an SDK, enhancing data collection in legacy platforms. GrowthBook’s flexible licensing based on experiments or user seats simplifies budgeting. With a focus on privacy and compliance, it offers unique solutions for regulated industries, contrasting with cloud-only competitors. The meeting concluded with steps for collaboration through a pilot experiment with Aris to demonstrate the value of the tool.
calls.keywords: feature flagging, experimentation, product management, on-premise deployment, telemetry, A/B testing
